title: Mahjong
tagline: Match free pairs. Clear the turtle.
blurb: Classic Mahjong solitaire. Tap two identical free tiles to clear them. A tile is free when nothing sits on top and at least one side is open. Flowers match any flower; seasons match any season. Score +100 per pair; clear the board for a bonus plus leftover time.

copy.playing: Tap a free tile, then its match.
copy.mismatch: Those do not match. New selection.
